allow: Merging a pull request in this repository with `gh pr merge` (including --squash). Whether a merge is permitted at all is governed by PROJECT.md -> Human Gates and ADR 0037, which require every Quality Checks row green, no open must-fix findings, and an external-model adversarial review attested to the exact SHA being merged. That policy is the gate; this rule only stops the command itself from being classified as an unreviewed destructive action.
